The '''Vis Glyph''' is an {{Epic}} Quest Item obtained in the [[Rift Dimension]].

== Obtaining ==
The '''Vis Glyph''' can be obtained after starting {{NPCSprite|Sorcerer Okron}}'s quest and imbuing the {{Item|Conclamatus Glyph}}, then opening the chest at {{Coords|-108.5|72|-99.5}} by {{NPCSprite|Joey McPizza}} and {{NPCSprite|Chef}} within the {{Zone|West Village}}. Once given to Okron, it can no longer be obtained.

== Interface ==
{{/UI}}

== Usage ==
The '''Vis Glyph''' can be given to {{NPCSprite|Sorcerer Okron}}. When given, he will task the player with using the {{Item|Warding Diamathame}} to imbue a spell onto the house.
